profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Marriott International
profile.summary: First-generation college student turned experienced software developer with proven track record leading teams in front-end iOS Development. Over the last decade, I’ve developed a native iOS interface for accepting user payments compliant with PCI standards. During this time, I served as the App Store manager for an iOS application with over a million users. I have experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, including but not limited to product owners and quality assurance professionals. I’m fluent in Swift, SwiftUI, ObjC and am experienced in Git, GitHub, and integrating distributing software such as Jenkins.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.insights: Mobile Application Development and Mobile Enterprise

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked as part of an agile team consisting of developers, UX designers, and testers to deliver a redesigned Marriott mobile app for iOS. Utilized JIRA, Confluence, and Git to work efficiently as a part of a team. Adhered to the principles of Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).

positions.title: iOS Development Consultant
positions.description: Implemented high-level design for mobile applications in iOS using Xcode. Worked as a member of an agile software development team to deliver functional and efficient code.Made use of JIRA, Git, Confluence, and other software tools to code as a team member.

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description: Designed and developed mobile applications for IOS and Android using Apache Cordova to implement a ReST-ful design along with adapting a card swipe device API. Maintained a local test server run on JBoss using MySQL Workbench. Developed basic Java code for back end server functions.

positions.title: Android Development Intern
positions.description: Developed an Android application communicate with established server to display information about printing systems and jobs currently being processed and in queue. The application also integrated a barcode scanner to display specific info based on the barcode scanned.
